bio.text: Della Au Belatti has represented House District 26 (Makiki, Tantalus, Punchbowl and Papakōlea) in the Hawaii House of Representatives since being elected in 2006.
Belatti is a practicing attorney, a former high school social studies teacher, and has served as a State Campaign Spending Commissioner.
Belatti was House Majority Leader from 2018 to 2022, and her legislature biography states that she currently chairs the House Committee on Public Safety.
